items.t: Strong surf damages historic Jupiter Civic Center, forcing closure as crews work to protect building

items.t: Cracked: In South Texas, new Congressional lines divide neighbors

items.t: 83-year-old prepares for 51st NYC Marathon
items.x: David Obelkevich is the only person to complete every NYC Marathon since 1976. He's going for his 51st consecutive race this weekend.

items.x: Mary Peltola's campaign was involved in efforts to recruit a second Dan Sullivan for Alaska's Senate race, The New York Times reports. The candidate is now on the ballot alongside the GOP incumbent.
